Platform.switchHint: Switching signs out and clears product data before signing in to the target organization.
Platform.signedInventory: Products come from the committed signed release and are filtered by IAM.
Platform.emptyHint: This identity has no visible installed products. Refresh or switch accounts.
Platform.discoveryHint: Cached products are not used as installation truth. Changes are disabled.
Platform.notFoundHint: This route does not exist or its product is not available to this identity.
Platform.readOnlyHint: The product is not ready or its observation is stale. Diagnostic reads remain available; changes are disabled.
Platform.dashboardHint: Start with an installed product. Identity, readiness and business data retain their own authority.

Auth.title: Sign in to Matrix
Auth.description: One identity. Your authorized products and workspaces.
Auth.securityHint: Session credentials stay only in page memory. Reloading requires sign-in.
Auth.passwordHint: After changing your password, sign in again with the new password.
Auth.requiredChangeHint: This session can only change the initial password. Sign in again afterward.
Auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
Auth.logoutUncertain: The local session was cleared, but server-side sign-out was not confirmed.

Collection.scopeHint: Only successfully inspected resources are shown. This is not the organization's inventory. The current API uses ID lookup.
Collection.emptyHint: Look up a resource ID or create a resource.
Collection.name: Name
Collection.idHint: 1–128 characters, starting with a letter or number. Dots, underscores, colons and hyphens are allowed.
Collection.nameHint: 1–63 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens. Start and end with a letter or number.
Collection.success: Completed. The platform response has been loaded.
Collection.safeCopy: Only validated public fields are shown.
Collection.queryHint: Look up an exact resource ID. The table contains only resources inspected in this session.
Collection.notSaved: Drafts are not saved before submission.

Draft.title: Leave unsaved changes?
Draft.description: This draft has not been submitted and will be discarded.
Draft.busyDescription: Wait for the current operation to finish to avoid duplicate submission.
Draft.failure: Could not finish leaving. Try again.

Errors.INPUT: Check the fields against the public API requirements.
Errors.SESSION: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Errors.DENIED: This identity is not allowed to perform this operation.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: The resource was not found in this organization.
Errors.CONFLICT: The resource state or request intent conflicts. Reload it.
Errors.VERSION: The resource version has changed. Refresh and retry.
Errors.LIMIT: The platform request or resource limit was reached.
Errors.UNAVAILABLE: A platform dependency is temporarily unavailable.
Errors.CONTRACT: The response does not match the current public contract and was not displayed.
Errors.NETWORK: The request did not complete. Check the connection and retry.
Errors.CANCELLED: The request was cancelled or timed out.
Errors.SCOPE: The response does not belong to this organization and was rejected.

Paas.valuesHint: Normal configuration is injected as ENV. Do not enter secrets here.
Paas.revisionHint: Published revisions are immutable. Deployments bind an exact revision.
Paas.requestAccepted: Request accepted. The Operation and deployment observation determine the final outcome.
Paas.alreadyCreated: The application was created. Configuration is next; failed steps can be retried.

Devops.originHint: Use a canonical HTTPS origin with no path, query or user information.
Devops.refsHint: Only opaque references belong here. Secret values, files and private CAs never enter the browser.
Devops.logEmpty: No logs after the current cursor.
Devops.logTruncated: Earlier logs have expired under the retention policy.
Devops.operatorHint: Configure references and trust from private files on the installation host, then schedule recheck. These are safe command templates only.
Devops.cancelHint: Cancellation records intent. External effects are reconciled first.
Devops.readOnlyProfile: This release uses fixed offline Go verification, no dependency egress and an isolated executor.
Devops.logWindowLimited: The local display window was capped; server logs are unchanged
